description: Call the comment UDF from J20 in its supported text-only mode and verify the note text.
declarations: Dim testSheet As Worksheet, oldActiveSheet As Object
Dim oldFormula As Variant
Dim commentText As String
setup: If Not testSheet.Range("J20").Comment Is Nothing Then commentText = testSheet.Range("J20").Comment.Text
check: CStr(result) = "Note" And commentText = "SMF test note"
expected_text: Cell result Note and a comment whose text is exactly SMF test note; no external image is requested.
coverage_note: The formula selects pChoice=0, the documented text-only path. Picture download and chart-provider modes require separate provider-specific checks. A missing comment is an assertion failure.
